content: You should respond to the Absence Management team's welcome back email by confirming your return to work date [1]. This email is sent about a week before your expected return [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Eligibility, Entitlement and Planning Your Leave > Returning to Work]
It’s important to acknowledge that returning to work after Parental Leave can be difficult. Even with smooth reentries, life and work interplay differently when one adds another member to their family. Everyone transitions differently, and the impact on an individual varies depending on role, as well as a litany of personal factors.

About a week before your expected return, the Absence Management team will send you a welcome back email which will share resources and ask you to confirm your return to work date. **Please respond by confirming the date you will return.**

More Return-to-work Resources shared [here](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

[2] [GitLab Inc (US) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security: Security You Can Count On > Disability Protection]
1. The Absence Management team will guide you through the application process. This will include:
   a. Providing you with filing options (online portal, phone, or paper)
   b. Providing NYLife with the employer eligibility intake information
   c. Sending you the Assignment of Benefits form

2. After 26 weeks (maximum benefit period), you'll need to determine if you can return to work

**Returning to work:** Email leaves@gitlab.com a physician's Return to Work authorization at least 5 calendar days before your planned return date. Include any needed accommodations.

**If you can't return after 26 weeks:** You'll move to unpaid leave with the option to continue benefits through COBRA. You can also apply for long-term disability at this time.

NYLife Claim Process for Short-Term Disability

**Step 1: Submit Your [Short-Term Disability](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1guydUTEc0vBFMaa_IsSktZ5hXAbOXdvD/view?usp=sharing) Application.** Complete the claimant portion and have your physician finish the rest. You can either:

- Send directly to NYLife (using the mail/fax number on the form), or
- Return to leaves@gitlab.com who will submit it for you

Let the Absence Management team know which option you choose.

**Step 2: NYLife Review Process**

[3] [Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Eligibility, Entitlement and Planning Your Leave > How to Initiate Your Leave]
- This request will route to the Absence Management team who will gather information and next steps relevant to your location. You can expect to receive an email within 48 hours of your submission (please keep in mind that this may vary depending on your timezone).
- **We understand that babies arrive on their own schedule!** If you need to change your leave dates, please contact the Absence Management team to make those edits, as team members cannot edit dates themselves once the request has been approved in Workday.
- For adoptions where 30-day notice isn't possible, notify your manager as soon as possible and enter the dates into Workday when you can.

***FAQ: Do I need to submit any paperwork?***  Yes, and this will vary depending on your location. Details of what is needed will be shared with you by the Absence Management team once they’ve had a chance to review your request and gather all relevant information. However, please be prepared to share proof of birth/relationship and/or adoption within 15 calendar days from the start of your leave. This can include a picture of the crib card, copy of paperwork from the hospital or birth center, or documentation with your child’s date of birth/placement noted. Documentation can be emailed to the Absence Management team at leaves@gitlab.com.
